title: Lacuna sweep: 2025-26 ML papers on multi-agent accountability, attribution, rollback
outcome: Find the most relevant recent papers, research directions and open hypotheses in Lacuna that our Sprint 1 web research missed
acceptance: uses Lacuna search_lacuna (paper, cluster, hypothesis, resource) with Lacuna URLs cited
≥8 relevant papers 2025-2026 with 1-line relevance each, ranked
names the closest competitor work to per-agent selective undo, with how we differ
linked code/datasets/benchmarks we could reuse for the 10-agent eval
summary:
Closest containment competitor: Airlock (2611.06727): provenance DAG + min-cut containment, keeps healthy work (+68 to +96 pp), but does not undo landed effects.
Closest selective-undo prior art: Wang et al. 2608.10502 (single-agent dependency-guided rollback + selective replay) and State Footprints 2610.03140 (vision: abort one task's writes + its readers). Ours: multi-agent, per-agent identity, containment + undo + tamper-evident audit.
12 ranked 2025-26 papers; structure helps attribution (Who&When 14.2% step vs 55.2% graph reading, different methods/splits; no further inference). BICR = Benign Infection Control Rate = 1 - ASR.
No ready 10-agent fault-injection benchmark: build our own, reuse Airlock/ARIA/Who&When metrics.
OpenAI-HF July 2026 incident verified (RES-11, METR). Papers read as Lacuna summaries. See Errata (v2).
